description: Reject a plan step on a motion, with an optional reason. Requires editor role on the motion. Use get_motion first to see the plan and read the step's number.

motion_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the motion UUID.

reason.description: Why it is rejected (max 2,000 chars). Left empty, Monnet asks the user for the explanation.

step_path.description: The step's number as get_motion prints it: "2" for a top-level step, "1.2" for the second step inside the first group.

name: reject
